# hiok_virtual_machine (Data Source)

Look up an existing virtual machine by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hiok_virtual_machine" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_ip` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `vcpu_count` (Number)
- `vm_id` (String)
